audience: People with a Weixin account (Tencent's mainland China version of WeChat)
parameters.description:
`msg-to-weixin` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`) and delivers it as a Weixin message to your own Weixin account, through the inbound webhook of your own [Weixin iLink Gateway](https://github.com/Kadxy/weixin-ilink-gateway) instance.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) as a JSON POST to `https://<your instance>/webhook/<token>`, using the host and token in your stored secrets, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional gateway instances bound per enrollment.

Set up: enroll in `kadxy/weixin-ilink-gateway`, keep (or replace) its generated Weixin API key and Webhook token, open the instance's `/console` and scan the QR code with the Weixin account that should receive messages. Then save the instance's host (for example `abc123.unitysvc.app`, no scheme) as WEIXIN_GATEWAY_HOST and its Webhook token as WEIXIN_WEBHOOK_TOKEN. Messages go to that logged-in account; the gateway sends text only.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Weixin account by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway, delivered through your Weixin iLink Gateway instance.

host.description: This enrollment's Weixin iLink Gateway host (no scheme). Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.

token.description: This enrollment's gateway Webhook token. Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.
